title: Panna Metrics Architecture
text: xRAPM use PSR prior. xRAPM uses SPM (predicted RAPM box scores). PSR separate downstream product uses decay-weighted skills predict xG differential. cousins, parent-child: SPM: elastic net predicting RAPM raw season stats (prior xRAPM) PSR: glmnet predicting xG diff decay-weighted career skills (standalone rating) Skill SPM: elastic net predicting RAPM decay-weighted skills (prior skill xRAPM) Two parallel pipeline variants exist: Opta Ratings Pipeline (data-raw/player-ratings-opta/): Uses raw season stats SPM Estimated Skills Pipeline (data-raw/estimated-skills/): Replaces raw averages decay-weighted career skills, re-runs SPM/xRAPM/Panna share RAPM design matrix (splints + xG target step 04).

title: Panna Metrics Architecture
text: Offense: positive = good (xG created) Defense: negative = good (xG suppressed) Overall: offense - defense (good defense contributes positively overall)

title: CLAUDE.md — panna R Package
text: Two-path rating system (mirrors torpverse TORP pattern): Key functions: - aggregate_player_game_epv() — Per-game EPV offensive/defensive decomposition - calculate_psv() / calculate_psv_components() — Per-game stat value, osv + dsv = psv - create_wp_features() → train_wp_model() → add_wp_vars() — WPA pipeline (draw = 0.5) - assign_wpa_credit() → aggregate_player_game_wpa() — WPA credit split per-game aggregation - calculate_epr() / calculate_epr_batch() — Legacy: Bayesian-shrunk EPV ratings decay - calculate_epr_regression() / optimize_epr_decay() — Production: weighted ridge player + league-season FE + opp_def_rating control. Inputs require opp_def_rating column joined cache-opta/team_season_strength.parquet. β_player EPR. Decay parameter near-irrelevant prediction (chosen 900 days via held-MSE) - build_player_game_ratings() — Merges EPV + WPA + PSV → piero_value - add_value_metrics_to_splints() — Joins per-game values RAPM splints multi-target - fit_spm_opta_target() — SPM custom target column (multi-target RAPM) Constants (constants.R): PANNA_EPR_WEIGHT = 0.5, PANNA_PSR_WEIGHT = 0.5 EPR defaults (player_ratings_epv.R): EPR_DECAY_OFFENSIVE = 400, EPR_PRIOR_GAMES = 10.2 WPA defaults (wp_credit.R): WPA_ACTOR_SHARE = 0.5, WP_DRAW_VALUE = 0.5
code: SPADL actions → EPV credits → per-game EPV → EPR (decay-weighted) ──┐                      └→ WP model → WPA → per-game WPA               ├→ piero_value (50/50 blend) Box-score stats → PSV/OSV/DSV (per-game via glmnet coefficients)     │ Stat ratings → PSR/OSR/DSR (smoothed skills via glmnet) ────────────┘      └→ Multi-target RAPM (xG, EPV, WPA, PSV as response variables)           └→ Match predictions (team-aggregated value metrics)

title: CLAUDE.md — panna R Package
text: WC expected-minutes tuning lives announced_squads.R — WC2026_EM_* constants (tournament_boost = 5, prob_prior_k = 1, tournament_start) feed announced derived squad resolvers. Values come WC2022 backtest (96 team-matches, game-2+; harness debug/wc_minutes_test/backtest_wc2022.R): boost 5 cuts minutes MAE 21.0→19.2, XI-hit peaks boost 3–5 degrades 8 (chases dead-rubber rotations). Don’t raise prob_prior_k: Beta prior monotonically worsens aggregate MAE — k=1 exists damp single-cap p_start = 1.00 pathologies. XGBoost minutes model benched, deliberately — minutes_model*.R/minutes_query.R feature-complete (incl. p_start_decay, within-tournament accumulators, prev-team-match involvement, training/query parity tests) LOSE tuned heuristic WC2022 holdout (22.4 vs 19.6 MAE, XI-hit tie). Don’t wire pipeline without re-running debug/wc_minutes_test/train_eval_xgb.R beating heuristic; top features heuristic’s signals, mostly adds variance. Published defense sign-flipped positive=good 10_export_blog_data.R blog consumption; internal model retains negative=good convention. panna_ratings.parquet shows defense “defensive value added” (xG suppression per 90). Replacement Level filter export — 10_export_blog_data.R drops player_id == "replacement" rows publishing. synthetic row model artifact (game-state confound, picks uncontrolled variance league-season fixed effects), coherent player rating. .get_col() warns missing columns — memoized warnings via .get_col_warned env utils.R compute_match_elos() time decay opt-— pass time_decay_halflife = N (days) scale K 0.5 ^ ((max_date - match_date) / N). Default NULL = decay (legacy behaviour). v5 Elo optimization treated tunable param converged near “” (~6500-day halflife), ’s default — callers wanting recency weighting set (~720 days ≈ 0.7 weight 1 year, matches FIFA / SPI intuition). WP model possession-team POV, home POV — since retraining 2026-05-19 WP model predicts P(team_in_possession wins). add_wp_vars() torp-style: wpa = fcase(team_id_next == team_id, wp_next - wp, default = (1 - wp_next) - wp). Never consume wp fixed-POV (home) probability subtract neighbouring rows — possession changes flip POV delta gets ~30× inflated. retro exact bug pannaverse/docs/backlog/CLAUDE_TODO_WPA_SCALE_REGRESSION.md (moved repo’s root — verse docs live one level , see pannaverse CLAUDE.md). Sanity bounds: per-event |WPA| ≤ 0.05 typically, per-match max ~0.5-1.0 (goal-causing events close games), per-season top players ±5-10. Pipeline-script skip signal typed condition, magic string — 10b/10c export scripts use skip_league_cond("reason") defined inline; outer tryCatch(..., panna_skip_league = handler, error = ...) dispatches class. add new league-iterating step, mirror pattern (.required_*_cols + validate_*_schema() helper) rather stop("__skip_xxx__") + (identical(e$message, ...)). Class dispatch robust message drift.

Production metrics backward-looking – “player actually game”. mental model: Sign convention: internally, defense stored negative--good (additive contribution opponent xG); published/blog columns flip positive always means “better”.

title: Player Ratings: EPR, PSR, Panna and Piero
text: Piero number shown main player rating blog. z-scored blend three complementary rating estimators, rescaled back panna’s units: weights (panna 0.5 / EPR 0.3 / PSR 0.2) live PIERO_WEIGHTS inside pannadata/scripts/build_blog_data.R – Piero function exported package. panna supplies three ingredient ratings (panna, EPR, PSR); blend publish step happen downstream pannadata. per-match twin follows idea blends production metrics instead: piero_value = 0.5 * epv_total_adj + 0.5 * psv, controlled package’s PANNA_EPR_WEIGHT / PANNA_PSR_WEIGHT constants (0.5/0.5) inside build_player_game_ratings(). per-match twin panna – single-game RAPM noisy useful, match-level “value added” side EPV + PSV .
code: piero = z(0.5 * z(panna) + 0.3 * z(epr) + 0.2 * z(psr)) * sd(panna) + mean(panna)

code: library(panna)  # Latest PSR leaderboard (top 50 by default) player_psr()  # As of a specific date -- snaps to the nearest weekly snapshot at or before it player_psr(date = "2026-03-18")  # Look up one player (partial, case-insensitive match) player_psr(date = "2026-03-18", player = "Salah")  # Top midfielders only player_psr(position = "MID") # Full per-stat skill profile with league/position percentiles. # Downloads ~2-3 MB of pre-computed skills + match stats on first call. player_skill_profile("Lionel Messi")  # Skill profile as of a past date (still uses the downloaded data) player_skill_profile("Kylian Mbappe", date = "2025-06-01") # Per-match value profile: EPV/WPA/PSV totals + per-90 rates + an EPR # estimate. Requires LOCAL pipeline cache output (data-raw/cache/epv/players, # data-raw/cache-skills/player_game_psv.rds) -- this one is not a fresh-clone # one-liner, it reads files the RAPM/EPV pipelines leave behind. player_value("Salah") player_value("Kane", season = "2024-2025") # Raw/derived Opta box-score aggregates -- the player_opta_*() family. # All share the same argument shape: player, league, season, min_minutes. player_opta_summary(player = "Kane", league = "ENG", season = "2024-2025") player_opta_shots(player = "Haaland", league = "GER") player_opta_passing(league = "ESP", season = "2024-2025", min_minutes = 900)  # Side-by-side comparison across shooting/passing/defending/chains compare_players(c("Salah", "Mbappe", "Haaland"))

Production – actually happened: per-action EPV WPA, per-game PSV, rolled piero_value (per match). Piero, headline blog rating, z-scored blend panna (0.5) / EPR (0.3) / PSR (0.2). title: Match-type K Lookup — ELO_MATCH_TYPE_K
text: Values OPTIMIZED via DEoptim v6 2026-05-29 using 3-fold CV 3-way logloss + Davidson draw model + venue factor + tunable decay. v6 = v5 retrained expanded intl corpus (post-2026-05-29 scrapes: AFCON 2023 Cote d'Ivoire, AFC/CAF/CONMEBOL WCQ historical cycles 2002-2014, etc., ~4,000 intl matches total). Decay halflife converged 7000 days (essentially "" – recent matches need extra weight; data set enough recent signal). Best CV-mean logloss = 0.9782 (vs v4 seed 1.0135, -3.49%). Pre-2026-05-29 values (file: WC=80, continental=80, qualifier=25, friendly=5). v6 dropped WC + continental K substantially (80 -> 44 / 50) raised qualifier (25 -> 59) – WC 2022 + extra qualifier cycles training set, individual matches need move Elos less prior better-anchored. Note: 94/110/55 numbers appeared v3/v4 intermediate DEoptim seed comments optimizer trial points, production constants ever shipped file.

title: Build expected-minutes profile for a national team — build_team_expected_minutes
text: team Character. National team name (matches team_name lineups). lineups Data.table lineups columns: team_name, match_id, match_date, player_id, player_name, position, is_starter, minutes_played, sub_on_minute, sub_off_minute, competition. as_of Date. "Today" decay calculation. Default Sys.Date(). lookback_days Integer. consider matches within window. Default 730 (2 years – covers WC qualifiers + internationals). half_life_days Numeric. Exponential decay half-life. Default 365. Recent matches weight 2x matches year ago. squad_size Integer. Cap returned roster many. Default 26. international_only Logical. Restrict international competitions (WC, EURO, qualifiers, Copa, AFCON, Nations League, friendlies). Default TRUE. min_recent_days Integer. Drop players appearances within window (relative as_of). Default 540 (~18 months) – catches players retired since last major tournament (EURO/Copa) still keeping current squad members injury gaps. shrinkage_k Numeric. Bayesian pseudo-count: effective_em = em x weight_total / (weight_total + k). Players weak evidence get shrunk toward zero. Default 3 (player 3 weighted caps gets 50% raw EM; 20 weighted caps gets ~87%). prob_prior_k Numeric. Beta-prior pseudo-count start/sub probabilities: p_start = (weight_start + k x base) / (weight_total + k) base squad-wide decay-weighted start rate. Stops single-cap player getting p_start = 1.00 (halve one omission). Default 1 — WC2022 backtest showed raw frequencies already well calibrated aggregate (higher k monotonically worsens minutes MAE), prior kept just strong enough damp thin-history pathologies. Set 0 legacy raw frequencies. tournament_boost Numeric. Weight multiplier applied matches tournament_comps /tournament_start — lets -tournament selections outweigh equally-recent qualifiers/friendlies. Default 1 (boost). applied tournament_start supplied. tournament_comps Character vector competition codes boost applies . Default "World_Cup". tournament_start Date. First day current tournament; boost applies tournament_comps matches /date (previous WC four years back boosted). Default NULL = .

title: Calculate EPR via weighted ridge regression with league/opponent FE — calculate_epr_regression
text: player_game_epv Per-game EPV data. Required columns: player_id, player_name, match_date, minutes_played, epv_offensive, epv_defensive. Recommended additional columns: league (competition), season_end_year, opp_def_rating (continuous opponent defensive strength, e.g., RAPM-derived team ratings). ref_date Snapshot date – matches strictly used. decay Exponential decay constant days time weight. alpha glmnet mixing parameter (0 = pure ridge, recommended). lambda Optional lambda. NULL, uses median 30-lambda path (good ridge sensible default shrinkage). prior_strength Equivalent-games prior shrinking small-sample players toward 0. Implemented adding "phantom" zero-y rows weighted prior_strength player. Set 0 disable. tier_interaction TRUE (default), fit player * league-tier interaction – .e. player gets two beta coefficients, one tier-1 (top-5 + UCL + WC/EURO) one tier-2 (everything else). fixes cross-league standouts (Tavernier Rangers, Veerman PSV) whose single-beta compromise elite domestic per-90 modest UCL/UEL per-90. Set FALSE legacy "one beta per player" behaviour. Ignored league_offsets supplied, since offsets supersede coarse two-tier split continuous per-league calibration. league_offsets Optional data.table per-league EPV calibration offsets compute_league_offsets. Must columns league, offset_off, offset_def. supplied, per-row response shifted UCL-equivalent scale via y_off <- y_off + offset_off[league] (likewise defence) regression runs, beta_player directly comparable across leagues. Leagues present table treated zero offset single warning issued. verbose TRUE, print step timings.

title: Calculate Physical Discontinuity — calculate_physical_discontinuity
text: Opta uses team-relative coordinates team sees x=100 attacking goal. possession changes, coordinates appear "jump" due perspective change, ball movement. function removes artifact converting coordinates single reference frame. validation purposes, physical discontinuity low action types (median < 10-15 units). High values indicate data quality issues unusual game situations (e.g., set pieces). title: Compute per-league per-90 EPV offsets vs an anchor league — compute_league_offsets
text: game_logs Per-game EPV data. Required columns: player_id, match_date, league, minutes_played (total_minutes), epv_offensive, epv_defensive. Typically rbinded game_logs_*.parquet files data-raw/cache-predictions-opta/. ref_year Reference year used compute recency weight. Defaults max(year(match_date)) + 1 (.e., upcoming season). half_life Years exponential decay season weights (default 3). anchor_league Anchor league string (default "UCL"). Offsets reported relative league's group-stage games. exclude_qualifiers TRUE (default), drops UCL/UEL/UECL qualifier rounds (matches September 15 season-end-year) feature weaker teams inflate anchor's apparent difficulty. min_ucl_n, min_dom_n Minimum number games league bridging player-season count (defaults 4 8). min_ucl_mins, min_dom_mins Minimum minutes league bridging player-season (defaults 180 720). min_n_for_same_season Minimum player-seasons needed "-season" preferred career-trajectory (default 20). min_career_games Minimum games per league career-trajectory bridge (default 10). chain_intermediates Candidate intermediate leagues chaining leagues without direct anchor bridge. prefer_chained_for Character vector league codes chained estimate used even direct career-trajectory bridge available. Default c("BRA") Brazilian-league bridges UCL dominated career-stage bias (young--developing Brazil, peak Europe), direct estimate unreliable. verbose TRUE (default), prints per-league summary.

title: Compute per-league per-90 EPV offsets vs an anchor league — compute_league_offsets
text: data.table one row per league plus anchor row: league League code. method "-season", "career-direct", "chained", "anchor". anchor Anchor league used. n_obs Number bridging player-seasons (-season) player-pairs (career/chained). offset_off, offset_def, offset_tot Per-90 EPV offsets anchor-equivalent scale.

title: Compute per-league per-90 EPV offsets vs an anchor league — compute_league_offsets
text: Three estimators tried per league, priority order: "-season" – player, season, leagues. Cleanest eliminates career-stage confounds. "career-direct" – player across career, leagues. Broader coverage; bias career-stage effects. "chained" – leagues direct anchor bridge, chain via intermediate league bridges.

title: Compute Elo Ratings for All Matches — compute_match_elos
text: results Data frame match_date, home_team, away_team, home_goals, away_goals columns, sorted date k K-factor (default 20) home_advantage Home advantage Elo points (default 65) initial_elo Starting Elo (default 1500) k_table Optional named numeric vector mapping league codes per-match-type K values (e.g., ELO_MATCH_TYPE_K). supplied, elo_match_k() selects K match league; otherwise every match uses single k argument. cross_conf_mult Numeric multiplier (default 1.0 = disabled) applied K home away teams different confederations. Lets model learn faster cross-confederation matches constrain relative ordering confederation prior centers. conf_priors Optional named numeric vector starting Elos per confederation (e.g., c(UEFA=1500, CONMEBOL=1500, ...)). supplied, teams initialized confederation's prior instead single initial_elo. Requires build_team_confederations() able derive team's confederation results. use_venue_factor Logical (default FALSE backwards compat). TRUE, home_advantage scaled compute_venue_factor() per match – +1 true home, 0 neutral tournament, -1 designated "home_team" actually visiting host country. time_decay_halflife Optional numeric (days, default NULL = disabled). set, scales K 0.5 ^ ((reference_date - match_date) / halflife) older matches contribute less Elo iteration. Useful recency-weighting; v5 optimization converged near "" (~6500 days), default available callers wanting FIFA/SPI-style recency. decay_reference_date Optional Date date-coercible string used "now" decay calculation. Defaults max(match_date) results. update_mode Passed update_elo(): "outcome" (default) "margin_sqrt" (xG-Elo form). "margin_sqrt" results carries home_xg/away_xg columns, update targets blended goals/xG margin (goal-diff fallback per row xG NA). blend_w, margin_slope Passed update_elo() margin_sqrt mode (weight goals vs xG, expected-margin-per-400-Elo).

title: Fit career-trait Panna (decay-weighted multi-season xRAPM) — fit_career_rapm
text: splint_data Splint list (cache-opta/03_splints.rds); needs splints match_id. match_dates data.frame/data.table match_id + match_date (e.g. opta_fixtures.parquet); gives splint age decay. skill_spm Skills-pipeline SPM object (cache-skills/03_skill_spm.rds); offense_spm_ratings$offense_spm defense_spm_ratings$defense_spm (player_id) prior. Ignored offense_prior/defense_prior supplied directly. halflife_days Recency half-life days: weight = 0.5 ^ (age_days /   halflife_days). Default 365 (~1 year) — tuned via optimize_panna_decay held-match prediction (365d best, monotone "shorter better"; objective near-flat, like EPR's, exact value non-critical 365 matches "best guess next game" intent). 2026-06-09. reference_date "" Date ages; default = latest match_date. min_minutes Minimum career minutes rated (else replacement pool). nfolds CV folds ridge fit. offense_prior, defense_prior Optional named (player_id) prior vectors override skill_spm. fixed_lambda Optional single ridge lambda (skips cv.glmnet). Default NULL = cross-validated. lambda_formula Optional function(n_obs) returning lambda; used fixed_lambda NULL. --date snapshot build passes sample-size formula (16.67 * n_obs^-0.58) reference date gets sample-appropriate lambda without re-running CV. n_obs count valid (finite) splint observations actually fed fit.

what: panna: Player Rating System for Football Using RAPM, SPM, and EPV Methods — panna-package
title: panna: Player Rating System for Football Using RAPM, SPM, and EPV Methods — panna-package
text: Implements player ratings football (soccer) 'Opta' event tracking-adjacent data. Combines Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus ('RAPM') Statistical Plus-Minus ('SPM') Bayesian prior, analysing time segments constant lineups ('splints') estimate player's contribution expected goals ('xG') differential. Action-level Expected Possession Value ('EPV') win probability added ('WPA') models support decay-weighted rating composites (EPR, PSR, Panna, Piero) plus match prediction tournament simulation.

title: Per-kick win probability and WPA for one shootout — score_shootout_kicks
text: WPA sign convention: positive = kick helped KICKER's team. scored kick small positive (0.75 conversion largely "priced "); miss larger negative (surprising outcome moves WP ). Sudden-death kicks swing far harder (±0.3-0.4) early regulation kicks (±0.05). Keep shootout WPA column — never add open-play WPA. single sudden-death kick (~±0.4) swamp whole match open-play events (~±0.05 ). Taker vs keeper attribution: missed kick's negative WPA split missed. keeper-SAVED miss (type_id == 15) partly keeper's , keeper_save_share (negative) WPA re-credited POSITIVE keeper_wpa opposing team's keeper, taker keeps rest. -target miss (skied/post, type_id 13/14) taker — keeper involvement. Scored kicks taker portion stay shootout_wpa. type_id absent, every miss treated -taker (simple default) keeper_wpa zero.
